source: A Transformer block looks simple in diagrams: normalization, attention, a feed-forward network, and two residual additions. The difficulty is that modern language models have changed almost every detail around that skeleton. Some normalize before a sublayer, some after it, some do both. The feed-forward branch may use ZXNAME0000XZ, ZXNAME0001XZ, ZXNAME0002XZ, GeGLU, or a sparse ZXNAME0003XZ. Attention may use ZXNAME0004XZ, ZXNAME0005XZ, ZXNAME0006XZ, ZXNAME0007XZ, RoPE, QK-Norm, local windows, or a KV cache during decoding.
zh: Transformer 块在图中看起来很简单：归一化、注意力、前馈网络和两个残差加法。困难在于，现代语言模型几乎改变了该骨架周围的每个细节。有些在子层之前进行标准化，有些在子层之后进行标准化，有些则两者都进行。前馈分支可以使用 ZXNAME0000XZ、ZXNAME0001XZ、ZXNAME0002XZ、GeGLU 或稀疏 ZXNAME0003XZ。注意在解码期间可能会使用 ZXNAME0004XZ、ZXNAME0005XZ、ZXNAME0006XZ、ZXNAME0007XZ、RoPE、QK-Norm、本地窗口或 KV 缓存。
